failure_history: Eight missing-feature failures were recorded before implementation. The initial implementation then passed seven tests but a new-listing fixture failed because it inserted NaN prelisting rows rejected by the existing data validator. The fixture was corrected to omit nonexistent prelisting rows; data validation was not relaxed. All eight targeted checks then passed. A manually transferred base64 text object failed exact-byte construction and was not committed or used; the subsequently uploaded gzip blob matches the original local SHA and is the only referenced raw-check artifact.

raw_checks.format: gzip-compressed UTF-8 JSON containing exact raw check logs

parent_attribution.qualification: Exact actual-fill decomposition, not a causal treatment effect or executed counterfactual. The hosted operation is instructed to publish every raw attribution row and the pinned origin identity.

design_boundary: This is the preregistered expanding-history design choice, not a bug fix or a change to old frozen acceptance. Original support and quantity-obligation implementations remain intact. No opportunity reassignment, leadership handover, protective-completion or forecast change is included.
